buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to

upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 4. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): Board of Officers as nominated by BRO Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: Board of Officers as nominated by BRO 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PQ CRITERIA/OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS FOR PROCUREMENT OF TRACKED PAVER 5M EXTENDED TO 7.5M 1. Performance Evaluation of Offered Vehicle. (a) If the offered vehicle is not trial evaluated in BRO. The bidder must be an OEM and must have sold in market a minimum 02 Nos of equipment of similar or higher capacity in last thre e years. Copies of related Supply Orders and Performance certificates, in support of these will be s ubmitted by the bidder. BRO reserves the right to conduct limited ‘No Cost No Commitment’ basis performance trials for a period of 50 hours operation at a mutually agreed project location includin g Vendor Premises. . OR (b) If the offered vehicle is trial evaluated in BRO and is not in service in BRO / Indi an Army. The offered vehicle has been trial evaluated and found successful in BRO/ has been fou

nd qualified in staff evaluation for procurement by Indian Army. Documentary proof in support of t his be enclosed. OR (c) If the offered vehicle is in service in BRO. The offered vehicle is presently in service with BRO and its Performance is Satisfactory. Performance of vehicle already inducted in BRO shall be evaluated internally by E4 (Repair)/TA Dte/HQ DGBR. In case found unsatisfactory, the bid of concerned bi dder shall be rejected. In this regard the decision of BRO is final. 2. Experience Criteria : The Bidder i.e. OEM (themselves or through resellers(s)) should have reg ularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products for 3 years before the bid opening d ate. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied a definite qu antity during each of the year. 3. ARAI Certificate: ARAI/ICAT/VRDE/GARC certificate of offered product should be in the n ame of the bidder. 4. Commissioning of equipment (By Seller). The equipment shall be commissioned by the Seller within a maximum period of 30 days from th e date of receipt of communication from the consignee confirming that the equipment is ready for co mmissioning. For any delay in commissioning of such equipment beyond 30 days of receipt of commu nication, a penalty @ 0.10% of the contract price per day per equipment, subject to a maxi mum of 10% of the value of non-commissioned equipments, shall be levied on the Seller. T his amount shall be recovered either from any payment due to the SELLER or from the Per formance Bank Guarantee, whichever is applicable. 5. Warranty (i) The SELLER warrants that the goods supplied under this contract conform to technical specific ations prescribed and shall perform according to the said Technical Specifications. (ii) The SELLER warrants for a period of 12 months or 1000 operational hours from the date of commissioning, whichever is earlier, that the goods/stores supplied under this contract and each c omponent used in the manufacture thereof shall be free from all types of defects/failures. (iii) Idling charges will be applicable for the period of defects. 6. Resources for providing spares & consumables for maintenance up to 10 years: The bid der should have adequate facilities pan India to carry out after sales service at various consignees for a tot al period of 10 (Ten) years including Guarantee/Warranty period of 01(One) year and 09 (Nine) years there after in terms of supply of spares. 7. Idling Charges. In case of defects developing during the warranty period, if the equipment is not put back in runnin g condition (by Seller) within a period of maximum of 21 days from the date of issue of notification, failing which the seller shall be liable to be charged an idling cost for the entire delay duration (Incl 21 days) @ IN R Rs. 20,595.00 (Rupees Twenty Thousand Five Hundred Ninety Five Only) per day subject to a maximum of 5% of the contract value, shall be levied on the Seller. If there is further such delay after reachin g this limit, the Procuring Entity shall be entitled to encashment of the whole of Performance Bank Guarant ee, besides recording the adverse performance of the contractor for future tenders. 8. Price to be quoted shall inclusive of GST & freight charges. 9. Engineering Support Package. (i) Tools. One set of tools required for undertaking regular and periodical maintenance, shall be provided along with the each equipment, on FREE OF COST.

(ii) MRLS. Three Set of hard copy of document containing Manufacturer Recommended List of Spares (MRLS) covering both repair & maintenance spares for 1000Hrs/2000 Hrs/5000 Hrs and list of one set document containing list of overhaul spares for 100 equipment shall be provided at the time of PDI. (iii) Technical Literature: All Technical Literatures (hard copy in English) described below shall b e supplied by the Seller on FREE OF COST along with each equipments:- (aa) Operation, Repair and maintenance manual for both engine and equipment. (ab) Workshop manual for both engine and equipment. (ac) Illustrated parts catalogue for both engine and equipment. (ad) Illustrated list of Special Maintenance Tools, if any. (ae) Lubrication charts for complete equipment. (af) In addition, following literature to be handed over to HQ DGBR/ E4 Tech :- (i) Illustrated parts catalogue of engine and equipment – 05 Sets. (ii) Running, Repair and Maint manual for both engine and equipment – 03 Sets. (iii) Lubrication charts for complete equipment – 03 Sets. (iv) Workshop manual for both engine and equipment – 02 Sets. (v) Soft copy of all above literature at S/No. (i) to (iv) – 01 Set. 10. This bid is reserved for OEM only. 11. Training: Successful bidder shall provide training at firm premises for operators and field wor kshop personnels. The training will be conducted for a minimum of Twenty One Days. The tr aining will be conducted in two Phases. Phase one training of Seven Days duration within 90 d ays post-delivery and Phase two training of Fourteen Days duration 90 days prior to terminat ion of warranty. 12. Diagnostic Tool Kit: 04 Nos vehicle Diagnostic Tool Kit (01 for each consignee) shall be provided by the successful bidder for effective field repair. The Vehicle Diagnostic Kit shall comprise of latest OBD H ardware Interface /Scan Tool, a fully compatible laptop with latest configuration and all required software li censes and diagnostic cables. 13. First-Aid Kit: The equipment shall be supplied with one complete first-aid kit, securely housed in a suitable, clearly identified container and containing the prescribed first-aid materials, including sterilised dressings, gauze, adhesive and waterproof plasters, bandages and other essential first-aid supplies, as app licable. The kit shall comply with the applicable statutory requirements and relevant current standards, wh erever applicable. All sterile and other time-sensitive items supplied with the First-Aid Kit shall have at lea st 90% of their total shelf life remaining as on the date of delivery of the equipment 14. The bidder shall submit a certificate on compliance of Rule 144 (xi) of GFR 2017 as per Ministry of Fin ance, Department of Expenditure , Public Procurement Division vide their order Nos dated 23 Jul 2020 and its subsequent Procurement Orders 2 and 3 dated 23 and 24 Jul 2020 vide their File No 06 / 18 / 2019. Model C ertificate enclosed as Appendix ‘A’. Appendix ‘A’

(Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached).’’ Stamped and Signed by Authorised Signatory on behalf of the Firm With Name, Appointment, Name of Firm, Phone No and Date .
